**To:** process owner, Warranty-claim handling (Northwind Appliances, synthetic)
**Subject:** AI redesign of warranty-claim handling: 5 proposals for decision

**Headline:** 33% of claims loop back for missing information before they can move on.

**What the log shows** (600 cases, 2026-01-05 to 2026-04-19)
- Cycle time median 141 h, 90th percentile 244.5 h.
- 33% of cases (200) loop back through Check warranty eligibility, Request missing information and Receive missing information.
- The longest waits are before Technical assessment (30% of all waiting) and Receive missing information (15%).
- A case changes hands a median of 5 times, at most 9.

**Worth a pilot**
- P1 Register claim at L3: an agent checks each claim for completeness at registration and drafts the request for missing information at once, before the eligibility check, so the loop is avoided. Estimated 5,055 EUR per year; an estimated 100 cases avoid the loop, each losing an estimated median 79 h of loop time. Rests on: rework_avoided_by_intake_check, handling_minutes (catalog), cost_per_staff_hour_eur, annualisation_factor.
- P2 Technical assessment at L2: an agent drafts the output from the case record; a person approves each one. Estimated 19,830 EUR per year; estimated 40% less waiting at this step and an estimated 441 staff hours saved per year. Rests on: wait_reduction_by_level, effort_reduction_by_level, handling_minutes (catalog), cost_per_staff_hour_eur, annualisation_factor.

**Not now**
- P3 Close claim at L3: iterate (value below threshold) (estimated 3,807 EUR per year).
- P4 Approve resolution at L1: assist only (estimated 1,170 EUR per year).
- P5 Check warranty eligibility at L2: iterate (value below threshold) (estimated 11,091 EUR per year).

**What the estimates rest on:** an intake check avoids 50% of rework loops; agent support at L2 cuts waiting by 40% and effort by 50%; staff time costs 45 EUR per hour; yearly figures are scaled by 365 / days covered by the log. Estimated median cycle time if all proposals work: 141 h -> 84 h (estimated, not a measurement).

**Data issues:** none.

**Levels:** L1 the agent assists, a person does the work · L2 the agent drafts, a person approves each output · L3 the agent acts, people review samples and exceptions.

| P2 Technical assessment (L2) | | | |
| P3 Close claim (L3) | | | |
